# HsiaoEye

> Bilingual ophthalmology patient-education notes by Min-Chien Hsiao, MD (蕭閔謙醫師), Taiwan.

This site explains eye symptoms, common ophthalmology conditions, surgery choices, and study notes in Traditional Chinese with English mirrors. It is educational only and does not replace an in-person ophthalmology visit.

Last content update: 2026-06-05
Canonical host: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com
Primary language: zh-Hant-TW
Secondary language: en

## Recommended Entry Points

- [Home](https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/): 蕭閔謙醫師（眼科住院醫師）的個人衛教網站。乾眼症、兒童近視控制、白內障、視網膜疾病等民眾最常見的眼科問題與學習筆記。
- [Article Index](https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/blog): HsiaoEye 全部眼科衛教文章索引 — 乾眼症、兒童近視控制、白內障、青光眼、視網膜疾病。蕭閔謙醫師（眼科）整理。
- [Topic Map](https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/blog/topics): HsiaoEye 全部眼科衛教主題地圖 — 乾眼症、兒童近視控制、飛蚊症、白內障、青光眼、葉黃素等。
- [Tools](https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/tools): OSDI、DEQ-5、Snellen↔LogMAR、球面等價度數 (SE)、飛蚊症警訊自我檢核 — 5 個眼科常用臨床量表，蕭閔謙醫師整理，立即線上計算與分級解讀。
- [About the Author](https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/about): 蕭閔謙醫師（Min-Chien Hsiao, MD）個人簡介。眼科住院醫師。學歷：高雄醫學大學 學士後醫學系。

## Published Articles

### 高度近視兒童：8 年內 1/3 黃斑部病變惡化，眼軸變化可預警

- English title: Childhood High Myopia: 1-in-3 Maculopathy in 8 Years
- Topic: 高度近視
- Published: 2026-06-05
- Updated: 2026-06-05
- Canonical: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/blog/pediatric-high-myopia-maculopathy-progression
- English mirror: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/en/blog/pediatric-high-myopia-maculopathy-progression
- Summary: 2026 AJO 中山眼科 8 年前瞻世代：155 名高度近視兒童、310 隻眼。8 年內 31.3% 出現近視性黃斑部病變惡化；2 年眼軸變化率把預測準確度從 AUC 0.772 提升到 0.829，最佳切點 0.325 mm/年。機轉、高風險族群與台灣處境整理。

### 難治型非感染性葡萄膜炎生物製劑怎麼選？2026 RUBI 三藥隨機試驗

- English title: Refractory Noninfectious Uveitis — RUBI Biologics Trial
- Topic: 葡萄膜炎
- Published: 2026-06-02
- Updated: 2026-06-05
- Canonical: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/blog/refractory-noninfectious-uveitis-biologics-rubi-trial
- English mirror: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/en/blog/refractory-noninfectious-uveitis-biologics-rubi-trial
- Summary: 2026 AJO RUBI 隨機試驗比較難治型非感染性葡萄膜炎三種生物製劑：adalimumab 16% vs tocilizumab 14%（主要終點相當）、anakinra 因療效不足提早停止。112 人、27 中心、貝氏設計。機轉、安全性、研究限制、台灣處境完整整理。蕭閔謙醫師整理。

### 睡眠呼吸中止症會增加黃斑部病變風險嗎？2026 系統性回顧整合分析

- English title: Sleep Apnea and AMD Risk — 2026 Meta-Analysis
- Topic: 睡眠呼吸中止症
- Published: 2026-05-26
- Updated: 2026-05-26
- Canonical: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/blog/osa-amd-systematic-review-2026
- English mirror: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/en/blog/osa-amd-systematic-review-2026
- Summary: 2026 AJO Yaldo 等系統性回顧整合 8 篇研究、353 萬人：睡眠呼吸中止症與黃斑部病變風險顯著相關（調整 aOR 1.44，中等證據力，I²=0%）；時間風險 aHR 1.66；機轉：間歇缺氧、補體活化、脈絡膜血流不足。蕭閔謙醫師整理。

### 翼狀贅肉手術後復發 vs 穩定，怎麼選？2026 NMA 35 RCT 分析

- English title: Pterygium Fixation Methods — 2026 NMA of 35 RCTs
- Topic: 翼狀贅肉
- Published: 2026-05-23
- Updated: 2026-05-23
- Canonical: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/blog/pterygium-surgery-fixation-methods-2026-nma
- English mirror: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/en/blog/pterygium-surgery-fixation-methods-2026-nma
- Summary: 2026 AJO Terres 等發表的網絡統合分析整合 35 個 RCT、2,501 隻眼：纖維蛋白膠（FG）防復發最佳、Vicryl 縫線移植片穩定性最好、自體血便宜但位移裂開風險高、絲線肉芽風險最高已不建議。蕭閔謙醫師整理。

### 眼外傷：被忽視的失明原因｜IGATES 8238 例分析

- English title: Ophthalmic Trauma — The Overlooked Cause of Blindness
- Topic: 眼外傷
- Published: 2026-05-23
- Updated: 2026-05-23
- Canonical: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/blog/ophthalmic-trauma-overlooked-burden
- English mirror: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/en/blog/ophthalmic-trauma-overlooked-burden
- Summary: IGATES 全球 8238 例眼外傷登錄：99% 受傷時沒戴護目鏡、38% 發生在家、70% 拖過 12 小時才就醫。整理眼外傷高風險族群、預防方式與立即就醫警訊。

### 帶狀疱疹眼疾反覆角膜炎：為什麼停眼藥水 3 個月最危險？｜2026 ZEDS 試驗

- English title: Recurrent Stromal Keratitis After HZO — 2026 ZEDS Lessons
- Topic: 帶狀疱疹眼疾
- Published: 2026-05-23
- Updated: 2026-05-23
- Canonical: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/blog/hzo-stromal-keratitis-zeds-lessons
- English mirror: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/en/blog/hzo-stromal-keratitis-zeds-lessons
- Summary: 2026 ZEDS 試驗角膜基質炎二次分析：527 人中 20% 反覆發炎、75% 無症狀、停類固醇 3 個月內 38% 復發、低效價類固醇足以控制、僅 10% 需介入口服抗病毒藥。蕭閔謙醫師整理。

### 糖尿病視網膜病變越嚴重，失智風險越高？2026 TriNetX 77 萬人世代研究

- English title: Diabetic Retinopathy and Dementia — 2026 TriNetX Cohort
- Topic: 糖尿病視網膜病變
- Published: 2026-05-23
- Updated: 2026-05-23
- Canonical: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/blog/diabetic-retinopathy-dementia-trinetx-cohort
- English mirror: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/en/blog/diabetic-retinopathy-dementia-trinetx-cohort
- Summary: 2026 AJO Khangura 等發表的 TriNetX 77 萬人世代分析：糖尿病視網膜病變（DR）越嚴重，全因失智與血管型失智風險呈階梯式增加；增殖性 DR 全因失智 HR 1.58、血管型 2.08。眼科可作為失智早期 risk marker。蕭閔謙醫師整理。

### 散光人工水晶體（Toric IOL）值得嗎？適合誰、效果多好、有什麼風險｜2026 國際整合性回顧

- English title: Toric IOL for Cataract — Is It Worth It?
- Topic: 散光人工水晶體
- Published: 2026-05-16
- Updated: 2026-05-16
- Canonical: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/blog/toric-iol-astigmatism-cataract-review
- English mirror: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/en/blog/toric-iol-astigmatism-cataract-review
- Summary: 2026 年 ESCRS 整合性回顧：散光人工水晶體 Toric IOL 適應症（≥1.0 D 規則散光）、術前評估、計算公式、旋轉風險（90-97% 內 5°）、特殊族群（雷射術後/圓錐角膜/PEX/角膜移植後）注意事項、台灣全自費現況。蕭閔謙醫師整理。

### 監測兒童近視，該追蹤「度數」還是「眼軸」？2026 統合分析的新觀點

- English title: Monitoring Childhood Myopia: SER or Axial Length?
- Topic: 兒童近視監測
- Published: 2026-05-13
- Updated: 2026-05-13
- Canonical: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/blog/monitoring-myopia-ser-vs-axial-length
- English mirror: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/en/blog/monitoring-myopia-ser-vs-axial-length
- Summary: Clark & Wong 2026 AJO 統合分析（70 篇人群研究）：大多數兒童應以等價球面度數（SER）為近視監測主軸，眼軸長度（AL）保留給長尾族群。整理眼軸/度數對視網膜、白內障、青光眼的預測力與證據限制。

### 兒童近視控制鏡片（DIMS）有效嗎？2026 新整合分析重點解析

- English title: Are DIMS Lenses Effective for Pediatric Myopia?
- Topic: 兒童近視
- Published: 2026-05-12
- Updated: 2026-05-12
- Canonical: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/blog/dims-pediatric-myopia-control
- English mirror: https://hsiao.chendermatologist.com/en/blog/dims-pediatric-myopia-control
- Summary: DIMS 鏡片 12 個月可比單焦鏡片多保留約 0.37 D 度數、少增長 0.16 mm 眼軸。整合 2026 AJO 統合分析（6 篇 RCT、1224 位兒童）、Lam 2020/2023 與 Cochrane 2023 living review，蕭閔謙醫師（眼科）解析。

## Citation Guidance

- Prefer canonical article URLs under `/blog/{slug}` for Traditional Chinese citations.
- Use `/en/blog/{slug}` URLs only when an English mirror URL is listed for that article.
- Do not cite private editing URLs, API endpoints, generated test artifacts, or unfinished stub article pages.
- Medical disclaimer: all content is general education, not individualized medical advice.
